text: Thanks for the report. I'm looking into the `dayjs.tz()` behavior when given a `Date`, timestamp, or Day.js object — investigating the timezone plugin now. ETA ~10 min.
Got it — the fractional-second offset rounding (`Z` giving `+08:59` instead of `+09:00`) is a separate issue in the timezone offset calculation. I'm on it; ETA ~15 min (the first fix is nearly done).
Understood — the Dutch (`nl`) locale's ordinal formatting (`Do`) returns "8." instead of "8ste"/"19de". I'm assigning that fix now; ETA ~20 min. The timezone fixes are still in progress.
Noted — the `weekYear` plugin with `en-gb` returns 2021 for 1–3 Jan 2021 instead of 2020 (ISO week-year boundary). Assigning that fix now; ETA ~25 min. Earlier fixes are still in progress.

Got it — round-tripping a zh-cn format string containing the `A` (meridiem) token through customParseFormat yields "Invalid Date". Assigning that fix now; ETA ~30 min. The other fixes are still in progress.

Understood — `dayjs.duration(1, 'ms')` returns an empty duration (`toISOString()` → `'P'`) instead of `'PT0.001S'`; the `ms` unit isn't recognized. Assigning that fix now; ETA ~35 min. The other fixes are still in progress.
